body:
Before this commit, when on first page, the "First" link was selected
AND disabled.

Ultimately it's overkill to have LinkList.js since Pagination is the
only one using it, should we remove this layer of abstraction?

comments.body: By analyzing the blame information on this pull request, we identified @bobylito, @Morhaus and @mthuret to be potential reviewers

We should remove this layer of abstraction if it simplifies the readability of the Pagination source code. 

Otherwise LGTM.

> We should remove this layer of abstraction if it simplifies the readability of the Pagination source code.

It should since we compute "disabled" and "selected" using different semantics, not very nice

title: fix(Pagination): when page === 1, first should not be selected
